title: Well-posedness for $p(x)$-Laplacian parabolic equations under a multiple-regime setting on an annulus
summary: This paper proposes an energy-variational framework for the well-posedness of the initial boundary value problem of the parabolic equation with variable exponents on an annulus, under the multiple-regime setting consisting of the subcritical, critical and supercritical regimes of the variable exponents. The multiple-regime setting leads to the appearance of the critical and supercritical regions of positive measure, which cause the failure of the classical Sobolev embedding and the lack of compactness.
